subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 2: Grammar – past simple and past continuous
outcomes: Form the past simple and past continuous correctly.
Use when and while to show an action that interrupts another.
Recognise stative verbs that are not used in the continuous.

tf.s: We form the past continuous with was/were + verb-ing.
We use the past simple for a short action that interrupts a longer action.
tf.why: Like 'I was cleaning when the phone rang.'

tf.s: 'Hear' is a stative verb, so we don't usually say 'I was hearing'.
We often use 'while' with the longer action.
tf.why: 'While I was walking home, it started to rain.'

tf.s: 'Know' and 'like' are often used in the past continuous.
tf.why: They are stative verbs, so we use the past simple.

tf.s: 'When we were arriving, all the guests were eating' is the best sentence.
tf.why: Arriving is the short action: 'When we arrived…'

boxes.q: Complete: I ___ my homework when my auntie rang.
boxes.why: The homework was in progress when she rang.

boxes.q: What is the past simple of 'make'?
What is the past simple of 'see'?
Complete: It ___ and I was standing at the bus stop getting wet.
boxes.why: Both are background actions in progress.

boxes.q: Complete: When we ___, all the guests were eating.
Choose: I ___ why she was upset.
What is the past simple of 'carry'?
Complete: ___ I was walking home, it started to rain.
Complete: ___ you take a lot of books with you?
Complete: At 7 a.m. yesterday, I ___ breakfast.
boxes.why: An action in progress at a time in the past.

hunt.q: I fell asleep while I ___ a film.

mcq.q: Which verb is NOT usually used in the past continuous?
What does the past continuous often show?
o: A longer action in progress in the past

mcq.q: What is the past simple of 'take'?
Choose: My phone ___ while I ___ my room.
mcq.why: Short action (rang) during a longer action (was cleaning).

mcq.q: Complete: I ___ (not need) a dictionary because I ___ (have) an app.
mcq.why: 'Need' and 'have' (own) are stative, so we use the past simple.

mcq.q: What were you doing at 8 p.m. yesterday? Choose the correct answer.
o: I read a book every day.
mcq.why: An action in progress at a past time.

mcq.q: Why is 'arrived' correct in 'When we arrived, all the guests were eating'?
o: It is the short action that happened during the longer one.
It is a long action in progress.

mcq.q: Why is 'I wasn't understanding why…' wrong?
o: 'Understand' is stative, so we use the past simple.
mcq.why: Stative verbs are not used in the continuous.

mcq.q: 'I was eating dinner when my friend called.' Which action started first?
mcq.why: The longer action was already in progress.
